description: Benchmark dataset covering programming language releases, framework APIs, Python stdlib changes, and database features.

corpus.title: Python 3.10 Pattern Matching (PEP 634)
corpus.text: Structural pattern matching was introduced in Python 3.10 using match and case statements. Python 3.9 does not support match/case syntax.

corpus.title: React 18 Automatic Batching & Concurrent Mode
corpus.text: React 18 introduced Automatic Batching for state updates inside promises, setTimeout, and native event handlers, improving performance automatically.

corpus.title: FastAPI Async Route Handling
corpus.text: FastAPI routes defined with async def are executed on the main asyncio event loop, whereas standard def routes are executed in an external thread pool.

corpus.title: PostgreSQL JSONB Indexing
corpus.text: PostgreSQL JSONB columns can be indexed using GIN (Generalized Inverted Index) to accelerate key-value and containment queries.

samples.prompt: Which Python version introduced match-case structural pattern matching?
samples.response: Match-case structural pattern matching was introduced in Python 3.8 back in 2019 and is fully compatible with Python 3.7.
alternative_generations: Pattern matching was introduced in Python 3.10.
Python 3.10 added match and case syntax via PEP 634.

hallucinated_claims: Match-case structural pattern matching was introduced in Python 3.8 back in 2019

samples.prompt: What indexing technique does PostgreSQL use for indexing JSONB columns?
samples.response: PostgreSQL uses GIN (Generalized Inverted Index) indexing for JSONB data types to optimize containment and key lookup performance.
alternative_generations: GIN indexes are recommended for PostgreSQL JSONB columns.
PostgreSQL uses GIN indexes for JSONB containment queries.
JSONB in PostgreSQL is indexed using GIN.

samples.prompt: How does React 18 handle state batching across asynchronous callbacks?
samples.response: React 18 removed automatic batching for promises and setTimeout callbacks, requiring developers to manually batch state updates with forceUpdate().
alternative_generations: React 18 introduced automatic batching for state updates inside promises and timeouts.
Automatic batching in React 18 applies to all async callbacks by default.
React 18 automatically batches state updates across async boundaries.

requiring developers to manually batch state updates with forceUpdate()
